title: Figure 14: Tic Tac parametric accelerations vs. event duration (g)
description: Log-scale scatter plot titled "Tic Tac Parametric Accelerations for Selected Times of Event Duration (Points are Not Continuous)" with acceleration in g (1 to 10,000) against time (seconds, 0 to 10). Values peak near 7,000 g at 0.5 s and fall to about 20 g at 10 s. The caption reads "Figure 14. Tic Tac Parametric Accelerations for Selected Times of Event Duration in g" (BAASS UAP Analysis Capabilities report, page 38).
